{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
{{Quote|It's very powerful. A masterpiece. It changed my life.|[[Klick (clone trooper)/Legends|Klick]]|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
'''''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge''''' was a [[holothriller]] produced prior to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], which purported to depict the [[Battle of Endor/Legends#Demise of the Sith|duel]] between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Skywalker took exception to its historical inaccuracies, specifically its depiction of him [[Death/Legends|killing]] Vader to avenge [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at Vader's hands, which he characterized as "''sick''". In actuality the holothriller was created by [[Cronal|Blackhole]], in order to establish that Luke Skywalker was the next legitimate heir to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] as Blackhole was secretly planning on becoming Luke Skywalker during the [[Battle of Mindor]].

==Inception==
{{Quote|Skywalker? Any relation to the guy from The Jedi's Revenge?|A Mindor Resistance fighter|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Cronal_TERC.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Cronal used Luke Skywalker's image to further his own agenda]]
[[Cronal|Lord Cronal]], codenamed Blackhole, was placed at the head of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet's]] operations during his brief tenure as the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]]. After the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] was defeated at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], control of the HoloNet slowly returned to the people as free speech increased in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Rather than threaten and intimidate citizens to return to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mindset, Cronal gave them what they wanted.<ref name="SPIN Declassified2">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> 

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was thrust into the spotlight in the immediate [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Battle of Endor thanks to his victories over [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Ssi-ruu]], [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], and the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]]. Cronal exploited Luke's skyrocketing reputation and poll ratings by privately producing the [[holothriller]]s ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Dragons of Tatooine]]'' and ''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge.''<ref name="SPIN Declassified2" />

==Synopsis==
{{Quote|Haven't you seen Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge?''"<br />"''Urn...''"<br />"''It's a dramatization, of course.''"<br />"''Of course.''"<br />"''But it's based on actual events.''"<br />"''Uh-huh.''"|Klick and Fenn Shysa|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge'' presented a twisted retelling of the events that occurred between the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] and the Battle of Endor. It was framed as a dramatization based on real events. The tale of Darth Vader's treason and the tragedy of Luke Skywalker were central to it's plot. Darth Vader was presented as a helpless cripple who's life was saved free of charge by the benevolent Emperor Palpatine at the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Vader was transformed into the most feared and powerful man in the galaxy after he was gifted mechanical arms and legs. While serving at the Emperor's side, Vader grew mad with ambition and pretended to play along with Palpatine's quest to rescue Luke Skywalker from the rebels.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> 

Luke Skywalker was the last remaining child of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] Hero Anakin Skywalker. Anakin had been Palpatine's most beloved protégé and the only Jedi to remain loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the Jedi Rebellion. When he met his untimely end during the rebellion, his son was taken by the rebels and ensnared in a web of lies. When Vader encountered Luke prior to the Battle of Endor, he insanely believed himself to be Palpatine's protégé and claimed he was Luke's father. He tried to recruit Luke to his treasonous plans, but the young Jedi rejected Vader's insane machinations.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />

When Luke Skywalker faced Emperor Palpatine face-to-face at [[Endor system/Legends|Endor]], the Emperor rejoiced and revealed to him his heritage. As Palpatine declared Luke the heir to the Empire, Vader's mind finally snapped and he attacked the Emperor in a mindless fury. Luke watched in horror as the [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armored]] monster fell upon the frail old man. He snapped from his dazed and cut Vader down, but was too late to save the Emperor from his mortal wounds. It was Skywalker's grief and guilt at his failure to save the Emperor that drove him back into the grasp of the Rebels as he believed he deserved no better than to be just another outlaw among the thieves, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and murderers of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />

==Reception==
{{Quote|They have me slaughtering my own father-to avenge the death of Palpatine! It's just-so sick.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge'' released prior to 5.5 ABY and circulated in systems still loyal to the Empire. Despite being cheaply produced, exaggerated, and hokey, the holothriller was a blockbuster hit. It also became a commercial powerhouse that spawned a successful line of [[action figure]]s.<ref name="SPIN Declassified2" /> Viewers considered ''Jedi's Revenge'' dark, gruesome, powerful, and a life-changing masterpiece. It was especially popular among [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] personnel, with even anti-Imperial [[Mindor resistance|resistance fighters]] having found interest in it. Luke Skywalker on the other hand was enraged by the work and sickened by the depiction of him killing his father to avenge the Emperor. Viewers on both sides of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] believed the events presented in ''Jedi's Revenge'' were true as there was little information on the events that occurred in the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Emperor's Throne Room/Legends|throne room]] outside of Luke Skywalker's vague testimony.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />

Cronal produced ''Jedi's Revenge'' to establish Luke Skywalker as the Emperor's true heir in the minds of the Empire's citizens. He presented the film to his troops and instilled the idea that the Empire's "Great Cause" was to rescue Luke Skywalker and restore him to his rightful place as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Cronal planned to capture Skywalker at [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] and [[Essence transfer|transfer his essence]] from his degrading body into the Jedi's youthful body. Once Cronal took control of the Empire from Luke's body, the Empire's citizens would have already been acclimated to the idea of Skywalker ruling as their rightful Emperor.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />

Had Luke perished prior to the essence transfer process, Cronal planned to use his sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] as a contingency. From Leia's body, Cronal would use her diplomatic and political connections to tear the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] apart from the inside. Any fumbles he might make upon meeting the princess's acquaintances would be explained as amnesia or traumatic brain injury from the [[Battle of Mindor]]. These excuses would be further reinforced by a holothriller Cronal planned to name ''Princess Leia and the Shadow Trap'' or ''Princess Leia and the Black Holes of Mindor.''<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />
